highlights.title: Deny can now say why
highlights.text: Tap Say why on an approval card, type what the bot should do instead, and it hears it right away. An empty field is a plain Deny.

highlights.title: Saying why never allows anything
highlights.text: The bot uses your words to try another way. Anything new it tries still asks you first, and the denied step still reads "You said no; nothing ran".
